svg.title: C05-M06-F1: The exploit lifecycle and where the ethical tester stops
svg.desc: The lifecycle from discovery through proof of impact, with the ethical tester stopping before the attacker's later stages.
svg.text: C05-M06-F1 The exploit lifecycle and where the ethical tester stops
Discovery -> Verification -> PROOF OF IMPACT -> | (ethical tester STOPS)
attacker would continue: weaponise -> deliver -> actions on objectives
ethical tester: demonstrate consequence, do not pursue it
Figure C05-M06-F1. The ethical tester proves impact and stops where an attacker would
